title: Inexhaustible
summary: INEXHAUST'IBLE, adjective [in and exhaustible.] 1. That cannot be exhausted or emptied; unfailing; as an inexhaustible quantity or supply of water. 2. That cannot be wasted or spent; as inexhaustible

inlines.v: INEXHAUST'IBLE, adjective [in and exhaustible.] 1. That cannot be exhausted or emptied; unfailing; as an inexhaustible quantity or supply of water. 2. That cannot be wasted or spent; as inexhaustible stores of provisions.
